{"reason": "All example false arbitrations fire on low-confidence events (0.44-0.91; six below 0.7), so I add a high-confidence? gate to the AND. Recall was already 1.0, so filtering low-confidence signals cuts false-arbitration-rate toward ~0.64 without dropping recall below the 0.8 gate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
